terms.gloss: to swear in (soldiers), bind them by the military oath
terms.grammar: adigō, adigere, adēgī, adāctum, with the soldiers in the accusative

terms.gloss: to take the military oath (of the soldier)

sources: Lewis & Short: sacramentum · Lewis & Short: adigo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 188, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
